purpose: 2-step execution smoke test, not quality or speed benchmark

settings.prompt: A clean black line drawing of a small bird perched on a flowering branch, simple flat embroidery design, complete centered composition, pure white background, no text, no fabric texture
settings.negative_prompt: photograph, cloth texture, watermark, letters, cropped subject

record.execution: manual UNet GPU, VAE CPU, no automatic offload hooks
record.weightLoading: sharded direct-to-GPU; loadSeconds not used to claim model speed superiority
record.scope: isolated process; generation includes cached tensor transfer and CPU tiled decoding, excludes frozen text encoding and disk loading; no FPGA inference
